}</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Speed curve per keyframe segment.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>padding-block</code></li><li>B. <code>grid-auto-rows</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>animation-timing-function</code></li><li>D. <code>background-clip</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5572">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5573 / 8000 · Practice 24</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5574">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5574" data-page="5574" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4697"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 24</span><span>Page 5574 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4697 — font × content-visibility</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">font</span> <span class="badge prop">content-visibility</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">content-visibility</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;font&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: font (obsolete). Skip rendering of off-screen subtrees (auto + contain-intrinsic-size).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;font&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><span style="font-family:serif;color:#ef4444;font-size:13px">Legacy: <font> is dead — use CSS</span></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;font face=&quot;Arial&quot; color=&quot;red&quot;&gt;text&lt;/font&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>content-visibility</b> = <b>visible</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>font { content-visibility: visible; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Forward / reverse / alternate playback.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>border-style</code></li><li>B. <code>place-content</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>animation-direction</code></li><li>D. <code>accent-color</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5573">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5574 / 8000 · Practice 24</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5575">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5575" data-page="5575" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4698"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 24</span><span>Page 5575 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4698 — acronym × flex-grow</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">acronym</span> <span class="badge prop">flex-grow</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">flex-grow</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;acronym&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: acronym (obsolete). }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Rotation of the element relative to the path (auto follows the tangent).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>left</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>offset-rotate</code></li><li>C. <code>font-variation-settings</code></li><li>D. <code>list-style-position</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5578">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5579 / 8000 · Practice 24</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5580">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5580" data-page="5580" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4703"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 24</span><span>Page 5580 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4703 — figcaption × background-position</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">figcaption</span> <span class="badge prop">background-position</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">background-position</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;figcaption&gt;</code> — the caption for a &lt;figure&gt;. Increment a CSS counter.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;summary&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px">Click ▸ <b>FAQ</b> to expand — <i>summary is the label</i></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;details&gt;&lt;summary&gt;FAQ&lt;/summary&gt;&lt;p&gt;Answer...&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/details&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>counter-increment</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>summary { counter-increment: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The value contains the substring.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:first-of-type</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>[attr*=…]</code></li><li>C. <code>:enabled / :disabled</code></li><li>D. <code>+</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5581">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5582 / 8000 · Practice 24</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5583">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5583" data-page="5583" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4706"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 24</span><span>Page 5583 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4706 — u × scroll-snap-align</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">u</span> <span class="badge prop">scroll-snap-align</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">scroll-snap-align</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;u&gt;</code> — non-extractive information: a spell-check red line, a signature. Where the child snaps inside the container (start/center/end).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;u&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">My name is <u>Ali</u>. — underlined, no meaning</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;My name is &lt;u&gt;Ali&lt;/u&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>scroll-snap-align</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>u { scroll-snap-align: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The element has keyboard/click focus.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:not(sel)</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:focus</code></li><li>C. <code>:placeholder-shown</code></li><li>D. <code>::after</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5582">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5583 / 8000 · Practice 24</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5584">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5584" data-page="5584" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4707"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 24</span><span>Page 5584 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4707 — data × transition-delay</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">data</span> <span class="badge prop">transition-delay</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">transition-delay</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;data&gt;</code> — a machine-readable value behind human-readable text. Wait this long before the transition starts.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;data&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Weight: <span title="85">85 kg</span> — value="85" is stored for machines</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Weight: &lt;data value=&quot;85&quot;&gt;85 kg&lt;/data&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>transition-delay</b> = <b>time</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>data { transition-delay: time; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “First child of its parent.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:has(sel)</code></li><li>B. <code>:lang(code)</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>:first-child</code></li><li>D. <code>::selection</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5583">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5584 / 8000 · Practice 24</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5585">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5585" data-page="5585" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4708"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 24</span><span>Page 5585 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4708 — sub × transform</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">sub</span> <span class="badge prop">transform</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">transform</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;sub&gt;</code> — subscript text (rendered below the baseline). Move/rotate/scale/skew the element (GPU-friendly, doesn&#x27;t reflow).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;sub&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">H<sub>2</sub>O and x<sub>1</sub></p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;H&lt;sub&gt;2&lt;/sub&gt;O and x&lt;sub&gt;1&lt;/sub&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>transform</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>sub { transform: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The n-th child (An+B formulas).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:required / :optional</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:nth-child(n)</code></li><li>C. <code>descendant (space)</code></li><li>D. <code>::backdrop</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5584">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5585 / 8000 · Practice 24</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5586">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5586" data-page="5586" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4709"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 24</span><span>Page 5586 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4709 — ul × height</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">ul</span> <span class="badge prop">height</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">height</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;ul&gt;</code> — a bulleted list of items. Sets the height of an element.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;ul&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><ul style="font-size:13px;margin:0;padding-left:22px;line-height:1.7"><li>HTML</li><li>CSS</li><li>JavaScript</li></ul></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ul&gt; &lt;li&gt;HTML&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;CSS&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;JavaScript&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ul&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>height</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>ul { height: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Last of its tag among siblings.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:in-range / :out-of-range</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:last-of-type</code></li><li>C. <code>::before</code></li><li>D. <code>*</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5585">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5586 / 8000 · Practice 24</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5587">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5587" data-page="5587" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4710"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 24</span><span>Page 5587 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4710 — picture × padding</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">picture</span> <span class="badge prop">padding</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">padding</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;picture&gt;</code> — wraps multiple &lt;source&gt; candidates to serve the right image per condition. Space inside the border (all four sides).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;picture&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;font-size:11px;font-family:monospace"><span>≤600px → thumb.jpg</span><span>webp → hero.webp</span><span>fallback → hero.jpg</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;picture&gt; &lt;source media=&quot;(max-width: 600px)&quot; srcset=&quot;thumb.jpg&quot;&gt; &lt;source type=&quot;image/webp&quot; srcset=&quot;hero.webp&quot;&gt; &lt;img src=&quot;hero.jpg&quot; alt=&quot;Hero&quot;&gt; &lt;/picture&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>padding</b> = <b>12px</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>picture { padding: 12px; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches if ANY listed selector matches (zero specificity!).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:dir(dir)</code></li><li>B. <code>::first-line</code></li><li>C. <code>#id</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:is(sel, …)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5586">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5587 / 8000 · Practice 24</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5588">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5588" data-page="5588" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4711"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 24</span><span>Page 5588 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4711 — math × border-radius</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">math</span> <span class="badge prop">border-radius</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">border-radius</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;math&gt;</code> — mathematical notation using mathml. Rounds the corners (all four in one declaration).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;math&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:serif;font-size:16px;text-align:center;padding:6px"><span style="display:inline-block;text-align:center;vertical-align:middle"><span style="display:block;border-bottom:1px solid #333;padding:0 4px 2px">a</span><span style="display:block;padding:2px 4px 0">b</span></span> = <span style="display:inline-block;text-align:center;vertical-align:middle"><span style="display:block;border-bottom:1px solid #333;padding:0 4px 2px">c</span><span style="display:block;padding:2px 4px 0">d</span></span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;math display=&quot;block&quot;&gt;&lt;mfrac&gt;&lt;mi&gt;a&lt;/mi&gt;&lt;mi&gt;b&lt;/mi&gt;&lt;/mfrac&gt;&lt;mo&gt;=&lt;/mo&gt;&lt;mfrac&gt;&lt;mi&gt;c&lt;/mi&gt;&lt;mi&gt;d&lt;/mi&gt;&lt;/mfrac&gt;&lt;/math&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>border-radius</b> = <b>50%</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>math { border-radius: 50%; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Value passes / fails validation.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>::after</code></li><li>B. <code>::cue</code></li><li>C. <code>:</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:valid / :invalid</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5588">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5589 / 8000 · Practice 24</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5590">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5590" data-page="5590" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4713"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 24</span><span>Page 5590 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4713 — textarea × flex-direction</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">textarea</span> <span class="badge prop">flex-direction</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">flex-direction</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;textarea&gt;</code> — a multi-line plain-text input field. The main axis direction of a flex container.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;textarea&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px;max-width:220px"><b style="font-size:11px">Message</b><div style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;padding:6px 8px;color:#9ca3af;min-height:44px">Write here…</div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;label&gt;Message &lt;textarea rows=&quot;3&quot; maxlength=&quot;200&quot; placeholder=&quot;Write here…&quot;&gt;&lt;/textarea&gt; &lt;/label&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>flex-direction</b> = <b>row</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>textarea { flex-direction: row; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The element is the target of the URL fragment (#id).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:target</code></li><li>B. <code>::selection</code></li><li>C. <code>.class</code></li><li>D. <code>:focus-visible</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5589">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5590 / 8000 · Practice 24</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5591">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5591" data-page="5591" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4714"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 24</span><span>Page 5591 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4714 — colgroup × column-gap</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">colgroup</span> <span class="badge prop">column-gap</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">column-gap</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;colgroup&gt;</code> — groups columns so they can be styled via &lt;col&gt;. Space between columns (grid columns / flex columns).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;colgroup&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;background:#f6f8fa;border:1px solid #d0d7de;border-radius:6px;padding:8px">col[0] width:70px<br>col[1..2] background:#fef9c3 <span style="display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;background:#fef9c3;vertical-align:-1px"></span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;table&gt; &lt;colgroup&gt; &lt;col style=&quot;width:70px&quot;&gt; &lt;col span=&quot;2&quot; style=&quot;background:#fef9c3&quot;&gt; &lt;/colgroup&gt; …rows… &lt;/table&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>column-gap</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>colgroup { column-gap: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Direct children only.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>::backdrop</code></li><li>B. <code>[attr=value]</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>:last-child</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5590">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5591 / 8000 · Practice 24</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5592">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5592" data-page="5592" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4715"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 24</span><span>Page 5592 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4715 — td × place-content</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">td</span> <span class="badge prop">place-content</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">place-content</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;td&gt;</code> — a standard data cell. “ALL following siblings.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>~</code></li><li>B. <code>*</code></li><li>C. <code>[attr*=…]</code></li><li>D. <code>:nth-of-type(n)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5591">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5592 / 8000 · Practice 24</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5593">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5593" data-page="5593" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4716"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 24</span><span>Page 5593 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4716 — tt × font-kerning</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">tt</span> <span class="badge prop">font-kerning</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">font-kerning</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;tt&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: teletype (obsolete). Break long words so they don&#x27;t overflow (break-word).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;pre&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><pre style="background:#0d1117;color:#e6edf3;font-size:11px;padding:10px;border-radius:6px;margin:0">function sum(a, b) { return a + b; }</pre></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code&gt;function sum(a, b) { return a + b; }&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>overflow-wrap</b> = <b>normal</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>pre { overflow-wrap: normal; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A section heading of importance level 3 (h1 = highest).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;bdi&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;center&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;details&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;h3&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5635">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5636 / 8000 · Practice 24</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5637">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5637" data-page="5637" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4760"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 24</span><span>Page 5637 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4760 — strong × align-content</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">strong</span> <span class="badge prop">align-content</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">align-content</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;strong&gt;</code> — marks text of strong importance, seriousness or urgency. Hint: the element will change this property soon (promote it to a layer).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;basefont&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px">body { font-family: Verdana; font-size: 14px; } — that replaced <basefont></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;basefont face=&quot;Verdana&quot; size=&quot;2&quot;&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>will-change</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>basefont { will-change: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches elements that HAVE the attribute.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>[attr]</code></li><li>B. <code>:last-child</code></li><li>C. <code>:is(sel, …)</code></li><li>D. <code>:lang(code)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5738">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5739 / 8000 · Practice 25</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5740">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5740" data-page="5740" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4863"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 25</span><span>Page 5740 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4863 — del × animation-fill-mode</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">del</span> <span class="badge prop">animation-fill-mode</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">animation-fill-mode</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;del&gt;</code> — marks text removed from the document (change tracking). Which styles apply before start / after end.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;del&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px"><del style="color:#9ca3af">Old price: $99</del> → <b>$79</b> <small>(deleted 2026-09-10)</small></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;del datetime=&quot;2026-09-10&quot;&gt;Old price: $99&lt;/del&gt; → $79</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>animation-fill-mode</b> = <b>backwards</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>del { animation-fill-mode: backwards; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The value ends with the string.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:nth-of-type(n)</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>[attr$=…]</code></li><li>C. <code>:checked</code></li><li>D. <code>descendant (space)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5739">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5740 / 8000 · Practice 25</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5741">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5741" data-page="5741" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4864"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 25</span><span>Page 5741 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4864 — meta × offset-distance</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">meta</span> <span class="badge prop">offset-distance</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">offset-distance</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;meta&gt;</code> — machine-readable metadata about the document (encoding, viewport, description, authors). Position along the offset-path (0%–100%).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;meta&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:12px;background:#f6f8fa;padding:10px;border:1px solid #d0d7de">charset=UTF-8<br>viewport=width=device-width<br>description="A huge HTML+CSS reference."</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;meta charset=&quot;UTF-8&quot;&gt; &lt;meta name=&quot;viewport&quot; content=&quot;width=device-width, initial-scale=1&quot;&gt; &lt;meta name=&quot;description&quot; content=&quot;A huge HTML+CSS reference.&quot;&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>offset-distance</b> = <b>percentage</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>meta { offset-distance: percentage; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The element is under the pointer.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:empty</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:hover</code></li><li>C. <code>:valid / :invalid</code></li><li>D. <code>::before</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5740">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5741 / 8000 · Practice 25</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5742">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5742" data-page="5742" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4865"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 25</span><span>Page 5742 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4865 — section × margin-right</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">section</span> <span class="badge prop">margin-right</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">margin-right</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;section&gt;</code> — a thematic grouping of content, typically with a heading. Distance to the right of the element.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;section&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="border-left:4px solid #4285f4;padding:8px 12px;background:#f0f6ff;width:250px"><b style="font-size:13px">Shipping</b><br><span style="font-size:12px;color:#444">A thematic <b>section</b> of the page</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;section&gt; &lt;h2&gt;Shipping&lt;/h2&gt; &lt;p&gt;We ship worldwide.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/section&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>margin-right</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>section { margin-right: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The element is being pressed/clicked.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:where(sel, …)</code></li><li>B. <code>:target</code></li><li>C. <code>::first-line</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:active</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5741">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5742 / 8000 · Practice 25</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5743">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5743" data-page="5743" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4866"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 25</span><span>Page 5743 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4866 — address × border-width</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">address</span> <span class="badge prop">border-width</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">border-width</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;address&gt;</code> — contact information for the author/owner of an article or page. Shorthand: grid-template-rows / grid-template-columns / grid-template-areas.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;q&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">As the docs say, <q>HTML is the skeleton</q>.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;As the docs say, &lt;q cite=&quot;https://w3.org/&quot;&gt;HTML is the skeleton&lt;/q&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>grid-template</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>q { grid-template: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Field required or not.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>::before</code></li><li>B. <code>::file-selector-button</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>:required / :optional</code></li><li>D. <code>[attr*=…]</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5746">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5747 / 8000 · Practice 25</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5748">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5748" data-page="5748" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4871"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 25</span><span>Page 5748 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4871 — code × font-style</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">code</span> <span class="badge prop">font-style</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">font-style</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;code&gt;</code> — a fragment of computer code. Indent the first line of a block.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;bdi&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Hello <bdi dir="auto" style="background:#fef9c3;padding:0 4px;border-radius:3px">مرحبا</bdi> world — isolated, layout-safe</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Hello &lt;bdi dir=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;مرحبا&lt;/bdi&gt; world&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>text-indent</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>bdi { text-indent: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Element&#x27;s text direction matches.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:dir(dir)</code></li><li>B. <code>::marker</code></li><li>C. <code>[attr]</code></li><li>D. <code>:first-child</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5748">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5749 / 8000 · Practice 25</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5750">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5750" data-page="5750" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4873"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 25</span><span>Page 5750 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4873 — dd × text-justify</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">dd</span> <span class="badge prop">text-justify</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-justify</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;dd&gt;</code> — the description (details) for a term in a description list. Games are now <canvas>/WebGL/JS.</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;applet code=&quot;Game.class&quot; width=200 height=100&gt;&lt;/applet&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>max-width</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>applet { max-width: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of position?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>static</code></li><li>B. <code>auto2</code></li><li>C. <code>never</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>relative</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5756">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5757 / 8000 · Practice 25</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5758">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5758" data-page="5758" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4881"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 25</span><span>Page 5758 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4881 — a × padding-top</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">a</span> <span class="badge prop">padding-top</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">padding-top</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;a&gt;</code> — creates a hyperlink to a page, a section, a file, an email, or a phone number. Inner space at the top (inside the border).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;a&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px;display:grid;gap:4px"><a href="#" style="color:#2563eb">W3Schools HTML <span style="font-size:10px">↗ (target=_blank)</span></a><a href="#" style="color:#2563eb">Jump to #contact</a><a href="#" style="color:#2563eb">Email us (mailto:)</a></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;a href=&quot;https://w3schools.com/html/&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; rel=&quot;noopener&quot;&gt;W3Schools HTML&lt;/a&gt; &lt;a href=&quot;#contact&quot;&gt;Jump to contact&lt;/a&gt; &lt;a href=&quot;mailto:hi@example.com&quot;&gt;Email us&lt;/a&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>padding-top</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>a { padding-top: length; href=&quot;style.css&quot;&gt; &lt;link rel=&quot;icon&quot; href=&quot;logo.svg&quot;&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>border-collapse</b> = <b>separate</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>link { border-collapse: separate; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of contain?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>none</code></li><li>B. <code>layout</code></li><li>C. <code>auto2</code></li><li>D. <code>never</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5758">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5759 / 8000 · Practice 25</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5760">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5760" data-page="5760" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4883"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 25</span><span>Page 5760 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4883 — div × z-index</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">div</span> <span class="badge prop">z-index</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">z-index</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;div&gt;</code> — a neutral block-level container with no semantic meaning. Stacking order of positioned elements (higher = on top).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;div&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="border:1px solid #d0d7de;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;background:#fafbfc;width:220px"><b style="font-size:13px">&lt;div class="card"&gt;</b><br><span style="font-size:12px;color:#57606a">a layout box with no meaning</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;div class=&quot;card&quot;&gt; &lt;h2&gt;Card title&lt;/h2&gt; &lt;p&gt;Card text&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/div&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>z-index</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>div { z-index: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of backface-visibility?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>visible</code></li><li>B. <code>hidden</code></li><li>C. <code>banana2</code></li><li>D. <code>auto9</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5759">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5760 / 8000 · Practice 25</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5761">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5761" data-page="5761" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4884"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 25</span><span>Page 5761 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4884 — main × flex-wrap</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">main</span> <span class="badge prop">flex-wrap</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">flex-wrap</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;main&gt;</code> — the dominant, unique content of the document. Whether flex items wrap to multiple lines.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;main&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="border:2px solid #4285f4;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;background:#f8fbff;width:260px"><b style="color:#1a56db;font-size:12px">MAIN CONTENT</b><br><span style="font-size:12px">Everything the user came here for lives inside <b>&lt;main&gt;</b>.</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;main&gt; &lt;article&gt;...the post...&lt;/article&gt; &lt;/main&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>flex-wrap</b> = <b>wrap-reverse</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>main { flex-wrap: wrap-reverse; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of justify-content?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>flex-start</code></li><li>B. <code>auto2</code></li><li>C. <code>never</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>center</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5760">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5761 / 8000 · Practice 25</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5762">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5762" data-page="5762" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4885"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 25</span><span>Page 5762 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4885 — h4 × order</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">h4</span> <span class="badge prop">order</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">order</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;h4&gt;</code> — a section heading of importance level 4 (h1 = highest). Changes the visual order of an item (without touching HTML).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;h4&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-weight:700;font-size:16.0px;line-height:1.25;margin:2px 0">Heading level 4</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;h4&gt;Heading level 4&lt;/h4&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>order</b> = <b>integer</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>h4 { order: integer; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of flex?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>none</code></li><li>B. <code>1</code></li><li>C. <code>auto2</code></li><li>D. <code>never</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5761">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5762 / 8000 · Practice 25</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5763">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5763" data-page="5763" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4886"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 25</span><span>Page 5763 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4886 — pre × place-self</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">pre</span> <span class="badge prop">place-self</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">place-self</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;pre&gt;</code> — preformatted text where whitespace and line breaks matter (code, diagrams). Shorthand: align-self + justify-self (one item).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;pre&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><pre style="background:#0d1117;color:#e6edf3;font-size:11px;padding:10px;border-radius:6px;margin:0">function sum(a, b) { return a + b; }</pre></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code&gt;function sum(a, b) { return a + b; }&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>place-self</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>pre { place-self: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of font-size?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>rem</code></li><li>B. <code>px</code></li><li>C. <code>never</code></li><li>D. <code>always</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5762">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5763 / 8000 · Practice 25</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5764">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5764" data-page="5764" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4887"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 25</span><span>Page 5764 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4887 — strong × font-optical-sizing</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">strong</span> <span class="badge prop">font-optical-sizing</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">font-optical-sizing</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;strong&gt;</code> — marks text of strong importance, seriousness or urgency. Use the font&#x27;s optical sizes (automatically pick the right cut).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;strong&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px"><strong>Warning:</strong> This action cannot be undone.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Warning:&lt;/strong&gt; This action cannot be undone.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>font-optical-sizing</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>strong { font-optical-sizing: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of font-optical-sizing?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>auto</code></li><li>B. <code>always</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>off</code></li><li>D. <code>banana2</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5763">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5764 / 8000 · Practice 25</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5765">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5765" data-page="5765" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4888"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 25</span><span>Page 5765 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4888 — cite × text-shadow</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">cite</span> <span class="badge prop">text-shadow</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-shadow</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;cite&gt;</code> — the title of a creative work (book, film, song, page). One or more shadows behind the text.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;cite&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Read <cite><i>Learn HTML5</i></cite> by freeCodeCamp.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Read &lt;cite&gt;Learn HTML5&lt;/cite&gt; by freeCodeCamp.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>text-shadow</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>cite { text-shadow: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of text-transform?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>none</code></li><li>B. <code>banana2</code></li><li>C. <code>auto9</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>capitalize</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5764">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5765 / 8000 · Practice 25</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5766">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5766" data-page="5766" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4889"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 25</span><span>Page 5766 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4889 — samp × text-orientation</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">samp</span> <span class="badge prop">text-orientation</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-orientation</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;samp&gt;</code> — sample output from a program or computer. How text rotates inside a vertical writing mode.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;samp&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">If you see <samp style="font-family:monospace;background:#fef2f2;color:#b91c1c;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px">404 Not Found</samp>, the page is missing.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;If you see &lt;samp&gt;404 Not Found&lt;/samp&gt;, the page is missing.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>text-orientation</b> = <b>upright</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>samp { text-orientation: upright; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of vertical-align?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>baseline</code></li><li>B. <code>auto9</code></li><li>C. <code>banana</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>middle</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5765">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5766 / 8000 · Practice 25</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5767">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5767" data-page="5767" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4890"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 25</span><span>Page 5767 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4890 — rp × caret-color</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">rp</span> <span class="badge prop">caret-color</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">caret-color</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;rp&gt;</code> — fallback parentheses for ruby annotations in browsers without ruby support. Whether the element can be dragged (legacy, mostly images).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;param&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;background:#f6f8fa;border:1px solid #d0d7de;border-radius:6px;padding:8px">name="quality" value="high" → passed to the object</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;object data=&quot;game.swf&quot; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of touch-action?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>none</code></li><li>B. <code>banana</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>auto</code></li><li>D. <code>solid2</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5770">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5771 / 8000 · Practice 25</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5772">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5772" data-page="5772" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4895"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 25</span><span>Page 5772 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4895 — output × offset-path</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">output</span> <span class="badge prop">offset-path</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">offset-path</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;output&gt;</code> — the result of a form calculation or user action. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of overscroll-behavior?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>contain</code></li><li>B. <code>banana</code></li><li>C. <code>solid2</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>auto</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5771">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5772 / 8000 · Practice 25</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5773">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5773" data-page="5773" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4896"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 25</span><span>Page 5773 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4896 — tfoot × margin-top</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">tfoot</span> <span class="badge prop">margin-top</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">margin-top</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;tfoot&gt;</code> — groups the footer (summary) rows of a table. Distance above the element (outside its border).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;tfoot&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:11px;border-top:2px solid #374151;display:flex"><div style="padding:4px 10px;font-weight:700">Total</div><div style="padding:4px 10px">$26,500</div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;table&gt; &lt;tfoot&gt;&lt;tr&gt;&lt;th&gt;Total&lt;/th&gt;&lt;td&gt;$26,500&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/tfoot&gt; &lt;tbody&gt;…&lt;/tbody&gt; &lt;/table&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>margin-top</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>tfoot { margin-top: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of appearance?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>auto</code></li><li>B. <code>always</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>none</code></li><li>D. <code>banana2</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5772">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5773 / 8000 · Practice 25</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5774">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5774" data-page="5774" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4897"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 25</span><span>Page 5774 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4897 — big × border</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">big</span> <span class="badge prop">border</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">border</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;big&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: big (obsolete). Shorthand: width + style + color for the whole border.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;big&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><span style="font-size:15px">Bigger text — via CSS font-size</span></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;big&gt;Bigger text&lt;/big&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>border</b> = <b>1px solid #d1d5db</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>big { border: 1px solid #d1d5db; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of animation-play-state?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>running</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>paused</code></li><li>C. <code>auto9</code></li><li>D. <code>banana</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5773">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5774 / 8000 · Practice 25</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5775">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5775" data-page="5775" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4898"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 25</span><span>Page 5775 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4898 — noframes × clear</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">noframes</span> <span class="badge prop">clear</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">clear</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;noframes&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: no frames fallback (obsolete). Prevents floats on one or both sides (moves the box below them).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;noframes&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px;color:#9ca3af">Frames are gone — so is <noframes>.</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;noframes&gt;Your browser doesn&#x27;t support frames.&lt;/noframes&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>clear</b> = <b>both</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>noframes { clear: both; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which global attribute: “Makes the element&#x27;s content editable in place. true / false / plaintext-only. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which global attribute: “Any ARIA attribute (aria-label, aria-expanded, aria-hidden, aria-live…) adds accessibility semantics when native HTML is not enough.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>aria-…</code></li><li>B. <code>dir</code></li><li>C. <code>itemid</code></li><li>D. <code>part</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5785">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5786 / 8000 · Practice 25</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5787">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5787" data-page="5787" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4910"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 25</span><span>Page 5787 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4910 — audio × transform</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">audio</span> <span class="badge prop">transform</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">transform</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;audio&gt;</code> — embeds an audio player (music, podcasts, sound effects). &lt;/template&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>text-underline-offset</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>template { text-underline-offset: length; &lt;h1&gt;My Blog&lt;/h1&gt; &lt;nav&gt;...&lt;/nav&gt; &lt;/header&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>writing-mode</b> = <b>vertical-lr</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>header { writing-mode: vertical-lr; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Sample output from a program or computer.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;datalist&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;samp&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;template&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;ul&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5803">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5804 / 8000 · Practice 25</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5805">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5805" data-page="5805" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4928"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 25</span><span>Page 5805 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4928 — video × padding-block</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">video</span> <span class="badge prop">padding-block</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">padding-block</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;video&gt;</code> — embeds a video player with optional controls, autoplay, loop and captions. type=&quot;application/pdf&quot; width=&quot;100%&quot; height=&quot;400&quot;&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>float</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>embed { float: none; “Matches every element.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:focus</code></li><li>B. <code>:first-of-type</code></li><li>C. <code>:valid / :invalid</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>*</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5895">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5896 / 8000 · Practice 26</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5897">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5897" data-page="5897" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5020"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 26</span><span>Page 5897 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5020 — param × max-height</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">param</span> <span class="badge prop">max-height</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">max-height</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;param&gt;</code> — a named parameter passed to an &lt;object&gt; resource. The upper limit of the height.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;param&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;background:#f6f8fa;border:1px solid #d0d7de;border-radius:6px;padding:8px">name="quality" value="high" → passed to the object</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;object data=&quot;game.swf&quot; type=&quot;application/x-shockwave-flash&quot;&gt; &lt;param name=&quot;quality&quot; value=&quot;high&quot;&gt; &lt;/object&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>max-height</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>param { max-height: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches by unique id.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>#id</code></li><li>B. <code>:first-child</code></li><li>C. <code>:not(sel)</code></li><li>D. <code>:target</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5896">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5897 / 8000 · Practice 26</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5898">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5898" data-page="5898" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5021"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 26</span><span>Page 5898 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5021 — option × padding-bottom</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">option</span> <span class="badge prop">padding-bottom</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">padding-bottom</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;option&gt;</code> — a single choice inside &lt;select&gt; or &lt;datalist&gt;. Inner space at the bottom.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;option&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px"><div style="padding:4px 8px;background:#eff6ff;border-radius:4px 4px 0 0">✔ Alpha</div><div style="padding:4px 8px;color:#9ca3af">Beta (soon) — disabled</div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;select&gt; &lt;option value=&quot;a&quot; selected&gt;Alpha&lt;/option&gt; &lt;option value=&quot;b&quot; disabled&gt;Beta (soon)&lt;/option&gt; &lt;/select&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>padding-bottom</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>option { padding-bottom: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The value starts with the string.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:nth-child(n)</code></li><li>B. <code>:has(sel)</code></li><li>C. <code>&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>[attr^=…]</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5897">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5898 / 8000 · Practice 26</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5899">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5899" data-page="5899" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5022"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 26</span><span>Page 5899 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5022 — output × outline</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">output</span> <span class="badge prop">outline</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">outline</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;output&gt;</code> — the result of a form calculation or user action. A line drawn outside the border (focus rings!).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;output&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px;font-family:monospace;background:#f0fdf4;border:1px solid #86efac;border-radius:6px;padding:8px;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center"><span>3</span>×<span>4</span>=<b style="background:#dcfce7;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px">12</b></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;input type=&quot;number&quot; id=&quot;a&quot; value=&quot;3&quot; aria-label=&quot;A&quot;&gt; × &lt;input type=&quot;number&quot; id=&quot;b&quot; value=&quot;4&quot; aria-label=&quot;B&quot;&gt; = &lt;output name=&quot;result&quot; for=&quot;a b&quot;&gt;12&lt;/output&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>outline</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>output { outline: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches an element in a state.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:last-of-type</code></li><li>B. <code>:required / :optional</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>:</code></li><li>D. <code>~</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5898">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5899 / 8000 · Practice 26</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5900">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5900" data-page="5900" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5023"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 26</span><span>Page 5900 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5023 — tfoot × overflow-x</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">tfoot</span> <span class="badge prop">overflow-x</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">overflow-x</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;tfoot&gt;</code> — groups the footer (summary) rows of a table. Horizontal overflow behavior (clip/scroll/auto/hidden).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;tfoot&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:11px;border-top:2px solid #374151;display:flex"><div style="padding:4px 10px;font-weight:700">Total</div><div style="padding:4px 10px">$26,500</div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;table&gt; &lt;tfoot&gt;&lt;tr&gt;&lt;th&gt;Total&lt;/th&gt;&lt;td&gt;$26,500&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/tfoot&gt; &lt;tbody&gt;…&lt;/tbody&gt; &lt;/table&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>overflow-x</b> = <b>keyword</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>tfoot { overflow-x: keyword; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Focus via keyboard (not mouse click).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:focus-visible</code></li><li>B. <code>:is(sel, …)</code></li><li>C. <code>:in-range / :out-of-range</code></li><li>D. <code>::first-letter</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5899">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5900 / 8000 · Practice 26</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5901">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5901" data-page="5901" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5024"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 26</span><span>Page 5901 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5024 — big × justify-content</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">big</span> <span class="badge prop">justify-content</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">justify-content</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;big&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: big (obsolete). Distributes flex items along the main axis.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;big&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><span style="font-size:15px">Bigger text — via CSS font-size</span></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;big&gt;Bigger text&lt;/big&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>justify-content</b> = <b>center</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>big { justify-content: center; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Last child of its parent.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:last-child</code></li><li>B. <code>:checked</code></li><li>C. <code>:dir(dir)</code></li><li>D. <code>::placeholder</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5900">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5901 / 8000 · Practice 26</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5902">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5902" data-page="5902" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5025"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 26</span><span>Page 5902 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5025 — noframes × grid-template-rows</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">noframes</span> <span class="badge prop">grid-template-rows</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">grid-template-rows</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;noframes&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: no frames fallback (obsolete).
