Aligns one grid item on the main axis inside its cell.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;slot&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><span style="color:#0d9488;font-size:13px">Hello shadow <i>(projected into the slot)</i></span></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;template shadowrootmode=&quot;open&quot;&gt; &lt;style&gt;span { color: teal; }&lt;/style&gt; &lt;span&gt;&lt;slot&gt;&lt;/slot&gt;&lt;/span&gt; &lt;/template&gt; &lt;my-comp&gt;Hello shadow&lt;/my-comp&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>justify-self</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>slot { justify-self: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “No children at all (not even text).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:target</code></li><li>B. <code>::after</code></li><li>C. <code>element</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:empty</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5902">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5903 / 8000 · Practice 26</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5904">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5904" data-page="5904" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5027"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 26</span><span>Page 5904 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5027 — base × line-height</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">base</span> <span class="badge prop">line-height</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">line-height</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;base&gt;</code> — sets the base url for all relative urls on the page. The height of each line box (vertical rhythm).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;base&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;background:#f6f8fa;padding:10px;border:1px solid #d0d7de">base URL = https://docs.example.com/ → &lt;img src="a.png"&gt; loads docs.example.com/a.png</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;base href=&quot;https://docs.example.com/&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>line-height</b> = <b>number</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>base { line-height: number; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Like :is but with ZERO specificity.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>::selection</code></li><li>C. <code>[attr]</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:where(sel, …)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5903">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5904 / 8000 · Practice 26</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5905">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5905" data-page="5905" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5028"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 26</span><span>Page 5905 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5028 — body × text-wrap</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">body</span> <span class="badge prop">text-wrap</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-wrap</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;body&gt;</code> — contains all the visible content of the html document. Modern line-breaking control (balance, pretty).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;body&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="border:2px solid #d0d7de;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;background:#fff"><h1 style="margin:0 0 6px;font-size:18px">Hello</h1><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Everything visible lives inside <b>&lt;body&gt;</b></p></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;body&gt; &lt;h1&gt;Hello&lt;/h1&gt; &lt;p&gt;World&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/body&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>text-wrap</b> = <b>pretty</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>body { text-wrap: pretty; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Form control usable or not.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:enabled / :disabled</code></li><li>B. <code>~</code></li><li>C. <code>::backdrop</code></li><li>D. <code>[attr$=…]</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5904">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5905 / 8000 · Practice 26</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5906">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5906" data-page="5906" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5029"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 26</span><span>Page 5906 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5029 — footer × color</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">footer</span> <span class="badge prop">color</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">color</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;footer&gt;</code> — footer content for a page or section: copyright, contact, related links. The text color of an element (and its descendants).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;footer&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="background:#111827;color:#9ca3af;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:12px;text-align:center">© 2026 Mega Book Inc. — <i>footer</i></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;footer&gt; &lt;p&gt;© 2026 Mega Book Inc.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/footer&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>color</b> = <b>#2563eb</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>footer { color: #2563eb; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The placeholder is currently visible (field empty).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>::first-letter</code></li><li>B. <code>*</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>:placeholder-shown</code></li><li>D. <code>:hover</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5905">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5906 / 8000 · Practice 26</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5907">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5907" data-page="5907" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5030"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 26</span><span>Page 5907 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5030 — h3 × color-scheme</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">h3</span> <span class="badge prop">color-scheme</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">color-scheme</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;h3&gt;</code> — a section heading of importance level 3 (h1 = highest). Declare light/dark support (form controls, scrollbars, canvas default bg).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;h3&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-weight:700;font-size:18.5px;line-height:1.25;margin:2px 0">Heading level 3</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;h3&gt;Heading level 3&lt;/h3&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>color-scheme</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>h3 { color-scheme: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Element&#x27;s language matches the code.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>::placeholder</code></li><li>B. <code>#id</code></li><li>C. <code>:active</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:lang(code)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5906">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5907 / 8000 · Practice 26</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5908">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5908" data-page="5908" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5031"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 26</span><span>Page 5908 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5031 — wbr × list-style-type</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">wbr</span> <span class="badge prop">list-style-type</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">list-style-type</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;wbr&gt;</code> — an optional line-break position inside long words/urls. The bullet/number marker style.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;wbr&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="width:110px;font-size:12px;word-break:break-word">https://example<wbr>.com/very/wbr/allows/line-breaks/here</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;a href=&quot;https://example.com/very/long/path&quot;&gt;https://example&lt;wbr&gt;.com/very/long/path&lt;/a&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>list-style-type</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>wbr { list-style-type: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Any depth descendant.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>descendant (space)</code></li><li>B. <code>::file-selector-button</code></li><li>C. <code>[attr^=…]</code></li><li>D. <code>:only-child</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5907">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5908 / 8000 · Practice 26</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5909">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5909" data-page="5909" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5032"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 26</span><span>Page 5909 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5032 — b × scroll-behavior</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">b</span> <span class="badge prop">scroll-behavior</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">scroll-behavior</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;b&gt;</code> — highlights text for utilitarian reasons without extra importance. Shorthand: property + duration + timing-function + delay.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;mark&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Search results for <mark style="background:#fef08a;padding:0 2px;border-radius:2px">html</mark> on this page</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Search results for &lt;mark&gt;html&lt;/mark&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>transition</b> = <b>all .3s ease</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>mark { transition: all .3s ease; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The first line of a block.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>[attr]</code></li><li>B. <code>:focus-visible</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>::first-line</code></li><li>D. <code>:not(sel)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5909">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5910 / 8000 · Practice 26</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5911">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5911" data-page="5911" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5034"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 26</span><span>Page 5911 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5034 — kbd × animation-play-state</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">kbd</span> <span class="badge prop">animation-play-state</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">animation-play-state</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;kbd&gt;</code> — represents user input, usually from a keyboard (shortcut keys). }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Contact information for the author/owner of an article or page.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;address&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;sub&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;tfoot&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;hr&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5950">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5951 / 8000 · Practice 26</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5952">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5952" data-page="5952" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5075"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 26</span><span>Page 5952 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5075 — input × text-justify</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">input</span> <span class="badge prop">text-justify</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-justify</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;input&gt;</code> — the most versatile form control: text, email, number, date, file, checkbox, radio, range, color, search and more. &lt;label&gt;Full name &lt;input type=&quot;text&quot; name=&quot;name&quot; required autocomplete=&quot;name&quot;&gt; &lt;/label&gt; &lt;label&gt;Email &lt;input type=&quot;email&quot; name=&quot;email&quot; required&gt; &lt;/label&gt; &lt;label&gt;Age &lt;input type=&quot;number&quot; name=&quot;age&quot; min=&quot;0&quot; max=&quot;120&quot;&gt; &lt;/label&gt; &lt;label&gt;&lt;input type=&quot;checkbox&quot; The browser adds vertical space around it automatically.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;This is a paragraph of text.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>z-index</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>p { z-index: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Represents user input, usually from a keyboard (shortcut keys).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;optgroup&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;noscript&gt;</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&lt;kbd&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;bdo&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5961">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5962 / 8000 · Practice 26</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5963">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5963" data-page="5963" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5086"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 26</span><span>Page 5963 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5086 — summary × flex-wrap</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">summary</span> <span class="badge prop">flex-wrap</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">flex-wrap</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;summary&gt;</code> — the visible caption of a &lt;details&gt; disclosure. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Vertical offset from the bottom.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>place-items</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>bottom</code></li><li>C. <code>color-scheme</code></li><li>D. <code>view-timeline</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5999">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6000 / 8000 · Practice 26</span> <a data-nav="next" href="../volumes/vol-13.html#p6001">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <script> (function(){ var pageEl = document.querySelector('.page[data-page]'); // keyboard document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.target.matches('input,textarea')) return; if(e.key === 'ArrowRight'){ var n = document.querySelector('a[data-nav="next"]'); if(n) n.click(); } if(e.key === 'ArrowLeft'){ var p = document.querySelector('a[data-nav="prev"]'); if(p) p.click(); } }); // jump (every page has one) var boxes = document.querySelectorAll('.jump-input'); for(var bi = 0; return; } var vol = Math.ceil(n / 500); location.href = 'vol-' + String(vol).padStart(2, '0') + '.html' + '#p' + n; }); })(boxes[bi]); } })(); </script> </body> </html>
